name: Care Senior Placement
imageAlt: Care Senior Placement website shown on a desktop display
body: Care Senior Placement offers a vital service for families navigating the emotional and logistical complexities of finding the right senior care — and we’re proud to support them with a streamlined digital experience that reflects their mission of compassion and clarity.

While we didn’t build their internal placement process, we helped enhance their web presence, creating a user-friendly platform where families can easily search by city or zip code, explore care homes, and request a free consultation. Their modern site is built to reduce stress, guide visitors step-by-step, and highlight the incredible concierge-style support they provide.
If you’re in Los Angeles, Orange County, or the surrounding areas, Care Senior Placement is a trusted, no-cost partner in finding the right care for your loved one.
result: Traffic increased by 33% in the first 60 days.
